§6Screens & Keyboards§f

§aA computer with no screen is just an expensive heater. Fix that.§f
Computers are headless by default. To see anything, you need a screen and a keyboard.

§6Screen Tiers§f:
§bTier 1§f: 50x16 monochrome.
§bTier 2§f: 80x25, 16 colors.
§bTier 3§f: 160x50, 256 colors.

§6Multiblock Displays§f:
Place screens next to each other and they merge into one big display, up to 8 wide and 6 tall. Each screen block costs 0.05 energy per tick, so a 3x2 array eats 0.3/tick.

§6Input§f:
Screens are output only. Attach a Keyboard to one face to type commands. Tier 2 and 3 screens also support direct mouse touch.

§ePS:§f Right-click a screen with a keyboard attached to open the terminal.
